title: Fix deployment failure by removing CDN-loaded PDF/ZIP dependencies

requirements.text: Eliminate reliance on CDN-loaded global scripts for jsPDF and JSZip by bundling them via the frontend build system, so the app builds and deploys reliably without external runtime dependencies.

quotes: can you fix the deployment error?

acceptanceCriteria: The app no longer includes external CDN <script> tags for jsPDF or JSZip in frontend/index.html.
frontend/src/lib/pdf/generateProductPdf.ts no longer reads jsPDF from window.jspdf and instead uses a module import.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts no longer reads JSZip from window.JSZip and instead uses a module import.
TypeScript builds without needing global Window type declarations for jspdf/JSZip.

requirements.text: Ensure the project builds and deploys successfully after the dependency change, with clear user-facing error handling if PDF or ZIP generation fails at runtime (English only).

quotes: can you fix the deployment error?

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend production build completes successfully without referencing window.jspdf or window.JSZip.
Product PDF generation still produces a valid multi-page PDF blob.
Product ZIP generation still produces a valid ZIP blob containing the expected files (PDF, cover image, templates/checklists/prompts folders when present, README.md).
If PDF or ZIP generation throws an error, the UI presents an English error message and the app remains usable (no blank screen/crash).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add migration.mo only if persistent state schema changes are required.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Adding new product features unrelated to deployment/build reliability.
Introducing external databases or additional backend services.
